_help.target_dpi: Raster resolution for scanned pages: 300, 400, 600, 800 or 1200. Higher = larger files and slower; it cannot add detail that the scan never had.
_help.output_mode: grayscale (recommended) or monochrome (pure black/white, photos are dithered).
_help.darkness_level: normal, strong, maximum_readable or low_toner. low_toner = darkest: all text and lines solid black and slightly bolder, for printers whose cartridge is running low (light grey prints as fading dots, solid black does not).
_help.sharpening_strength / denoise_strength /: "auto" uses the preset value, or give a number from 0.0 (off) to 2.0 (very strong).
_help.min_line_width_pt: "auto" uses the preset; or a number in points. Hairlines in digital PDFs are thickened to at least this width.
_help.mixed_page_mode: hybrid = keep vector text/graphics and enhance embedded images (selectable text is kept); rasterize = turn mixed pages into enhanced images at target_dpi.
_help.force_rasterize_all_pages: true = treat every page like a scan (maximum uniformity, loses selectable text).
_help.raster_compression: jpeg (small files, visually lossless at quality 90+) or lossless (bigger files).
_help.workers: "auto" or a number of PDFs processed in parallel. Use 1 on low-memory computers.
_help.generate_preview: true = save a before/after PNG of page 1 of each document into preview_folder.
